videos.title: How Marbles Are Made (No Hands Touch Them) 🔮
videos.description:
Recycled glass melted at over 1,000 °C, color squirted in for the swirl, snipped into glowing blobs, and rolled perfectly round by spinning steel rollers. The trick dates back to 1905.
Did you ever play marbles? 👇

videos.title: How Is Coca-Cola Made? (The Recipe Is in a Vault) 🥤
videos.description:
Born in an Atlanta pharmacy in 1886 for 5 cents a glass. Today a secret concentrate is shipped to bottlers, mixed with water and sweetener, chilled, carbonated under pressure, and sealed at up to 2,000 cans a minute.
Can or glass bottle: which tastes better? 👇

videos.title: How Pencils Are Made (There's Zero Lead in Them) ✏️
videos.description:
Pencil "lead" is graphite: miners in 1500s England mistook it for lead and the name stuck. Graphite plus clay (more clay = harder), baked at 1,000 °C, laid into grooved wood slats, glued into a sandwich, cut, painted, and topped with an eraser.
Do you chew your pencils? 👇
